name: @metorial/influxdb-cloud
description: Write and query time-series data with the InfluxDB Cloud TSM/v2 API using line protocol and Flux. Discover organizations and buckets; manage retention, scheduled tasks, dashboards, labels, API-token authorizations, secrets, Telegraf configurations, and DBRP mappings. Inspect monitoring checks, notification endpoints and rules, current-user identity, and task-run logs.
